preview.text: United Arab Emirates and Netherlands meet in a one-day match at ICC Academy Ground, following seven recorded one-day meetings where United Arab Emirates won 2 and Netherlands won 5. Netherlands won the toss and chose to bat first. The forecast for the next 8 hours shows up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 30 degrees.

summary.text: NED scored 263-4 in their innings, with Max O'Dowd as the top scorer with 106 off 119 balls, while Aayan Afzal Khan took 3 for 48. UAE replied with 266-5 to win by 5 wkts, led by top scorer Akshdeep Nath with 99 off 88 balls against Bas de Leede, who claimed 2 for 44.
